== English errata comparison sources ==
The November 1998 Glossary already explains the total-destiny rule. The 25 November 2020 PC posting changes the actual words, adding total and placing character after the hit phrase. The three branches, +3 and one-Force loss cost otherwise agree.

Aglets, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1322117#p1322117 Current Rulings and Errata], Players Committee, 25 November 2020. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=108|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 108. [[:File:CC-D-darkstrike.gif|Complete replacement face]]. Earlier ruling: Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf#page=45|Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, PDF page 45.
